lines.text: The psalm calls for a new song in the assembly of the godly, and for Zion's children to rejoice.
Israel is to praise His name with dancing and make music to Him with tambourine and trumpet.
The LORD takes pleasure in His people and adorns the afflicted with salvation; the saints are to shout for joy.
The psalm wants God's praises in the saints' mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands, to inflict vengeance.
The sword is to bind kings with chains and nobles with shackles of bronze, executing the judgment written against them.
